offers.title: AI Engineer, Computer Vision
offers.description:
About Niantic Spatial

At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment.

Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets — building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens.



About the Team

Localization is where the map meets the moment. Our localization team builds the living geospatial world model and the centimeter-level Visual Positioning System (VPS) that lets people and robots know exactly where they are, from any camera, almost anywhere on Earth.

That system is learned, not hand-built. Our localization stack has moved from classical geometry to visual models trained on billions of posed images — models that have to be accurate to the centimeter, robust to lighting and seasons and clutter, and fast enough to run in production for every query. This team sits at the junction of research and production: we take what works in a paper, make it work on our data, and make it work for customers.



About the Role

We're hiring an AI Engineer, Computer Vision, to contribute to the deep learning models at the heart of our localization system. Working alongside experienced researchers and engineers, you'll help train and iterate on the visual models — feature extractors, matchers, pose regressors, and retrieval models — that turn a single image into a precise position in the world.

This is a full-loop environment. You'll get exposure to the entire pipeline: the data the model learns on, training, evaluation, and the service that runs it in production. You'll be surrounded by people who care deeply about correctness — where a loss curve going down is not the same as a system getting better — and you'll grow into that rigor quickly.



What You'll Do

 - Train and Evaluate Models — Implement, train, and evaluate visual localization models in PyTorch: local feature extraction and matching, image retrieval, pose regression, and scene-coordinate regression. Iterate on architectures, loss functions, and training loops to improve accuracy on real production captures.

 - Build Data Pipelines — Contribute to high-throughput ingestion and preprocessing pipelines that turn raw imagery, poses, and 3D point clouds into training-ready datasets, including curation, sampling, and augmentation.

 - Run Experiments at Scale — Run training jobs across GPU environments on our 30-billion-image corpus, working with senior engineers and ML Infrastructure to keep experiments reproducible and results interpretable.

 - Extend the Benchmark — Help build and maintain the evaluation suite for localization — pose accuracy, recall across lighting and season changes, and latency under production load — so results are comparable across model versions.

 - Support Production Deployment — Work with senior engineers to take models from checkpoint toward serving: export, inference optimization, and monitoring once live. Learn what it means to own a model end-to-end, not just hand off a checkpoint.

 - Bridge Research and Product — Work with the Research team and Real-World Test Lab to understand how field failures translate into training data and benchmark improvements.



What You'll Bring

 - Experience training deep learning models for computer vision tasks in PyTorch — through coursework, research, internships, or early industry work.

 - Foundational understanding of at least one of: visual localization, learned feature matching, image retrieval, pose estimation, SLAM, or structure-from-motion, and the 3D geometry underneath them (camera models, epipolar geometry, pose parameterizations).

 - Comfort working with large image or 3D datasets — preprocessing, curation, and understanding how data quality affects model behavior.

 - Familiarity with GPU-based training and the ability to read and reason about training runs — identifying whether a bottleneck is in data loading, compute, or model architecture.

 - Strong Python skills and a habit of writing code that others can rerun and build on.

 - A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, computer vision, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



Nice to Have

 - Published or contributed to work on learned localization, visual place recognition, scene-coordinate regression, or vision foundation models (CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS, 3DV, or equivalent).

 - Experience with large-scale self-supervised or multi-view pretraining, or fine-tuning vision foundation models for geometric tasks.

 - Exposure to inference optimization for edge or mobile hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, CoreML, or similar).

 - Experience with petabyte-scale spatial data: point clouds, meshes, posed image collections, or geospatial indexing.

 - Background in robotics, augmented reality, 3D reconstruction, digital twins, or autonomous systems.

 - Prior industry or research internship experience shipping or contributing to a production CV system.



Compensation & Benefits

The expected salary range for this role is $165,600 - $221,000 per year. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and more.



Location & Work Model

This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office on a hybrid schedule with a minimum of 3 days per week in office.



Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for.



Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.



Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

offers.title: Software Engineer, Product
offers.description:
WHY NUMERIC

Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP), a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.

We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re hybrid but in-office first, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.

The Role

Our product teams are responsible for inventing the future of finance and accounting. We work at the whiteboard, we bring fresh eyes to a complex domain, we break down problems to their fundamentals, and we relentlessly seek the right answer to a problem.

We have teams in both SF and NYC that are hiring product engineers. There is no single exact profile of skill and background that can succeed, but we rather seek to understand your strengths and assemble teams that work excellently together.

You might be a fit if…

 - You care about finding the right abstraction

 - You find learning a new, complex domain to be an exciting challenge

 - You combine a commitment to high quality work with a desire to win and tackle ambitious goals

What you need

 - 5+ years of experience building software

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, or Physics

 - High motivation and agency

Bonus points for…

 - Experience with building software in complex domains

 - Fintech or accounting-adjacent experience

 - Experience founding a business or building products from scratch

 


HOW WE WORK

This role is hybrid in New York City, in-office first.

As an engineer at Numeric you will learn the domain, meet your users, and exercise substantial creativity and agency over product direction. You'll work with a high-pace, high-integrity team that loves collaboration.

We believe the best company is the one with the best ICs and we’ve built a culture to maximize great work. We believe great product & engineering come from a desire to win, a deep care for the craft, and a pragmatism in shipping for overall impact. As engineers we ground our work in our understanding of the users, the domain, and the goals for our organization.

We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

 - Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.

 - Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.

 - Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.

 - Earn the right: Our ability to rethink how things are done depends on the trust and reputation we build by shipping quality products and improving the lives of our users.

 - SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” We bring fresh eyes to a stagnated and underserved domain. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

 

Read some of our thoughts on engineering and company-building here. https://numeric.substack.com/

offers.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The ChatGPT Space team is building a shared workspace where people and AI agents turn ideas into polished, editable work. Space brings teammates, ChatGPT, and dots together around shared knowledge and projects, with creation experiences spanning Pages, Sheets, Slides, and new kinds of artifacts.

We want work to keep improving beyond the first draft, using shared context and collaboration to stay current as projects evolve. We work across product, design, and research, partnering closely with model training teams to shape how frontier models create and edit artifacts. We ship quickly, learn from real usage, and hold a high bar for craft, correctness, and speed.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Frontend Software Engineer to build a top-tier collaboration experience and help shape how people work with AI. This is a craft-heavy role: you’ll partner closely with design to prototype, iterate, and polish new interaction models, then turn them into reliable, high-performance product experiences.

You’ll help define what great looks like for collaboration between people and agents: how shared context is represented, how contributions and changes are made understandable, and how users stay oriented and in control as work moves between teammates and AI.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and ship polished, high-performance UI for Space and its collaborative workflows.

 - Partner tightly with design to turn prototypes into production-quality experiences, from layout and typography to motion and interaction details.

 - Develop intuitive interfaces for creating and editing shared content, organizing project context, and reviewing contributions from teammates and AI as work evolves.

 - Own frontend architecture decisions across component systems, state management, navigation, and rendering performance.

 - Improve quality and reliability through testing, instrumentation, accessibility, and thoughtful UX for loading, errors, and concurrent changes.

 - Collaborate with research, platform, and backend partners to bring model capabilities into cohesive creation, editing, and collaboration experiences.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Have strong experience with modern frontend stacks such as React and TypeScript, and a high bar for UI craft.

 - Love design engineering: sweating the details while keeping velocity.

 - Have built rich, interactive product experiences and care deeply about performance, responsiveness, and usability.

 - Enjoy exploring ambiguous problems and iterating rapidly with design and product.

 - Think in end-to-end workflows and can make complex interactions feel clear and intuitive.

 - Have experience with collaborative applications, rich-text editors, real-time interfaces, or AI-powered products (nice-to-have).

offers.title: Software Engineer, Shop/Feed Ads
offers.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Monetization team is a new cross-functional group spanning engineering, product, research, and design. We are building the foundational systems that will help OpenAI scale access to intelligence responsibly.

Our mission is to create user-first, privacy-preserving monetization products—including next-generation ads experiences—that strengthen trust, expand economic opportunity, and support OpenAI’s long-term innovation. We believe monetization should deliver clear user value, uphold rigorous privacy and safety standards, and sustain a healthy ecosystem for developers and businesses.

The team operates in a greenfield environment, moving quickly through prototyping, experimentation, and iterative deployment. We partner closely across Product, Design, and Research to bring new capabilities into real-world systems at global scale.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer to lead the design and development of the systems that turn advertiser feeds (eg. retail feeds, travel feeds etc.) into relevant, reliably delivered ads. In this foundational role, you will build across the full ads lifecycle—from ingesting and organizing retailer or travel catalogs into efficient retrieval systems, supporting ranking models, and serving ads at scale.

This role is well suited to an engineer with direct experience in product ads retrieval, ranking, and delivery, along with a strong understanding of merchant feeds and shopping systems such as Google Shopping, YouTube product ads, or Amazon. We also welcome engineers with Senior Staff-level or greater scope who have deep ownership of large-scale catalogs, search and indexing, ads serving, or closely related distributed systems.

You will independently own complex systems, make sound technical tradeoffs, and help define the architecture and roadmap for Shopping/Travel/Feed Ads. You will collaborate closely with Ads ML, Ads Delivery, Product, Design, and Research to connect accurate, fresh advertiser feed information with useful ads experiences in ChatGPT.

This role is based in San Francisco and Mountain View. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Design and build pipelines that ingest, validate, normalize, and refresh merchant product feeds, keeping catalog information accurate and available for serving.

 - Develop scalable catalog storage and indexing systems that make large inventories searchable and reflect changes in product availability, pricing, and attributes.

 - Build search and retrieval systems that efficiently identify relevant, eligible products across merchant catalogs.

 - Partner with Ads ML to connect product retrieval with ranking models through dependable interfaces, features, and serving infrastructure.

 - Engineer low-latency, high-throughput ads delivery systems with strong reliability and correctness guarantees.

 - Design real-time event pipelines and distributed storage that support catalog freshness, serving decisions, and downstream feedback.

 - Build observability and quality controls to detect feed errors, stale inventory, indexing delays, and serving issues.

 - Define technical direction and drive complex projects from early prototypes through production deployment and operation.

 - Operate systems with high engineering rigor through testing, monitoring, privacy and security reviews, and strong operational practices.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with direct ownership of product ads retrieval, ranking infrastructure, or delivery.

 - Understand merchant feeds and shopping systems, including how catalog quality, product availability, and freshness affect relevance and ads performance.

 - Have built systems for shopping or product ads at platforms such as Google Shopping, YouTube, Amazon, or a comparable environment.

 - Alternatively, have operated at Senior Staff-level scope or above, leading the architecture and delivery of large-scale catalogs, search and indexing platforms, ads serving, or related backend systems.

 - Have built low-latency, high-throughput services and data pipelines with demanding reliability and correctness requirements.

 - Can reason across ingestion, storage, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between freshness, relevance, latency, and cost.

 - Are comfortable partnering with machine-learning teams to bring ranking models and signals into dependable production systems.

 - Can define technical direction in an ambiguous 0→1 environment and independently drive complex work across teams.

 - Communicate clearly and make technical decisions grounded in user value, merchant experience, and long-term system health.

offers.title: Software Engineer, Life Sciences
offers.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Life sciences is one of the clearest areas where advances in intelligence can meaningfully benefit the world at large. The OpenAI Life Sciences team works at the intersection of advancing frontier life sciences model capabilities and building products to help scientists accelerate their research and leverage the full potential of AI for scientific work.

We’re building platforms that connect model intelligence with practical scientific workflows. Our work covers workflows from next-gen sequencing analysis to designing new drugs, helping scientists run computational workloads as well as access laboratory services. By making these capabilities more accessible and useful, we aim to improve early discovery and support downstream progress in drug development.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for experienced full-stack product engineers with strong backend skills to join our growing Life Sciences team.

This is an individual contributor role with substantial ownership. You’ll help define products, design systems, and ship experiences that connect scientists with AI capabilities and laboratory workflows. You’ll work across the stack, partnering with researchers, scientists, and infrastructure engineers to turn complex needs into reliable, intuitive products.

We value strong engineering fundamentals, product judgment, and experience shipping to large user bases. Life sciences experience is helpful, but you don’t need a scientific background to make a meaningful contribution.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Design backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect users with models, scientific tools, and laboratory services.

 - Create intuitive interfaces that help scientists navigate complex workflows.

 - Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, operation, and iteration.

 - Work with scientific and research partners to identify user needs and prioritize valuable product improvements.

 - Partner with dedicated infrastructure engineers on performance, reliability, and scaling.

 - Make thoughtful engineering decisions that balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have strong software engineering fundamentals and depth in backend development, alongside the ability to build across the stack.

 - Have shipped and operated products used by large user bases.

 - Bring strong product sense and can translate ambiguous needs into useful software.

 - Work autonomously, make sound technical decisions, and drive projects forward with limited direction.

 - Enjoy hands-on building and taking ownership within a lean team.

 - Are excited about advances in AI and how they could change scientific work.

 - Learn unfamiliar domains quickly and collaborate effectively with scientific and technical partners.


PARTICULARLY RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

 - Building AI applications, model-serving integrations, or inference platforms.

 - Developing marketplaces or products that coordinate services and complex workflows.

 - Taking new products from early concepts through launch and adoption.

 - Working with scientific tools, research data, or laboratory systems.

The Cooperative AI team is scaling OpenAI with OpenAI. We are building an AI powered knowledge system that evolves and learns as our products, systems and customers evolve. offers.title: Software Engineer, HSM Infrastructure Security, Consumer Devices
offers.description:
We are hiring a Security Software Engineer to design and implement the hardware-backed security foundations used across OpenAI’s device ecosystem.



A central focus of this role is hardening the boundary between our policy systems and the HSMs that protect sensitive cryptographic keys. This boundary determines which operations may be performed, what may be signed, which policies must be satisfied, and how changes to trusted software and policy are authorized.



You will develop security-critical software and firmware within, or immediately adjacent to, an HSM trust boundary. Depending on your background, this may include HSM trusted applications, firmware services, cryptographic mechanisms, device drivers, PKCS#11 components, secure-provisioning protocols, or signing-policy enforcement systems.



This is a hands-on software-engineering role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review production code, debug across hardware and software boundaries, and carry projects from initial requirements through deployment. It is not an HSM administration, PKI operations, compliance, or architecture-only position.



In This Role, You Will

 - Design and implement security-critical software and firmware for HSMs, secure elements, trusted execution environments, and hardware roots of trust.

 - Build and harden the policy-to-HSM boundary responsible for authorizing certificate issuance and cryptographic signing operations.

 - Develop HSM trusted applications, firmware components, host interfaces, device drivers, SDKs, or cryptographic service integrations.

 - Implement or extend cryptographic interfaces such as PKCS#11, OpenSSL providers or engines, platform key-storage APIs, or comparable hardware-security interfaces.

 - Build firmware and software that cryptographically enforces key generation, provisioning, usage, rotation, recovery, and destruction policies.

 - Design and implement HSM-backed certificate authority, code-signing, key-management, and device-identity systems.

 - Develop end-to-end cryptographic protocols spanning devices, secure hardware, policy services, and backend infrastructure.

 - Build security capabilities supporting device attestation, secure boot, factory provisioning and restoration, user registration, and authentication.

 - Design controls that make trusted software and policy changes verifiable, auditable, and subject to appropriate multi-party authorization.

 - Write, review, test, and audit secure embedded software for resource-constrained environments.

 - Develop test harnesses, emulators, fuzzers, and fault-injection tooling to validate security properties and failure behavior.

 - Threat-model hardware and software trust boundaries and translate findings into concrete engineering improvements.

 - Partner with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, application, and security teams to integrate secure-by-default capabilities into production systems.

 - Help establish engineering standards for HSM development, applied cryptography, secure key management, and certificate infrastructure.



Minimum Qualifications

 - 5+ years experience building secure embedded firmware for constrained environments

 - Deep programming experience in C, C++, or Rust.



You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have

 - A strong track record of designing, implementing, debugging, and shipping production systems software.

 - Hands-on experience developing security-critical software or firmware within, or directly adjacent to, an HSM, secure element, TEE, or hardware root of trust.

 - Experience developing one or more of the following:
   
   - HSM firmware or trusted applications
   
   - Cryptographic mechanisms or hardware-accelerated cryptographic services
   
   - HSM device drivers, host libraries, SDKs, or middleware
   
   - PKCS#11 providers, mechanisms, or integrations
   
   - Secure key-provisioning or key-injection protocols
   
   - HSM-backed certificate authority or code-signing systems
   
   - Signing-policy enforcement within a hardware-backed trust boundary

 - Strong knowledge of applied cryptography, digital signatures, key hierarchies, secure key management, and cryptographic protocol design.

 - Experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, certificate authorities, certificate issuance, and certificate lifecycle protocols.

 - Familiarity with secure boot, measured boot, device identity, remote attestation, or hardware-backed storage.

 - Experience reasoning about concurrency, memory safety, privilege separation, hardware interfaces, failure modes, and side-channel or physical attack considerations.

 - The ability to evaluate security designs and personally implement the software required to realize them.

 - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across hardware, firmware, backend, and product teams.



Additional Experience That May Be Helpful

 - Firmware development for ARM TrustZone or another trusted execution environment.

 - Experience with commercial or cloud HSM platforms such as Thales Luna, Entrust/nShield, Utimaco, Marvell LiquidSecurity, AWS CloudHSM, or comparable systems.

 - Experience with PKCS#11, KMIP, OpenSSL providers or engines, secure-element APIs, or platform-native key-storage frameworks.

 - Device manufacturing, secure provisioning, factory restore, or silicon bring-up experience.

 - Secure boot ROM, bootloader, firmware-signing, anti-rollback, or authenticated-update development.

 - Developing trusted applications or cryptographic services inside an HSM or secure coprocessor.

 - Hardware/software co-design involving cryptographic accelerators, secure processors, or custom silicon.

 - Multi-party authorization, quorum-controlled deployments, tamper-resistant audit mechanisms, or attestable policy systems.

 - Secure or private storage systems based on hardware-protected keys.

 - Experience sustaining high-assurance security software in production.

offers.description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com http://www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.



Do you love crafting beautiful and functional customer experiences? Want to work on interesting technical problems around integrations and payments? Do you have a passion  for Elixir and functional programming with a focus on building large, complex systems at scale? Peek is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer. The ideal candidate has 5+ years of development experience with Elixir, experience working with GraphQL APIs, MySQL, and familiarity with messaging queues such as RabbitMQ. In this role you will have the opportunity to take ownership of critical product areas and use AI tools as a force multiplier on top of your strong fundamentals.

 

Our engineering group works on several different products and systems: our Peek Pro operations management suite, embeddable scheduling & booking flows, and custom development services for our enterprise customers. This role will primarily focus on Connectivity via third party integrations and the Peek Pro “App Store”, and secondarily focus on payments-related initiatives.



We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer who works AI-first. That means you treat AI as a core part of how you build software and break down ambiguous problems, including delegating tasks to agents, reviewing their work critically, and course-correcting when things go sideways. You'll design and operate complex agent orchestration systems, develop patterns for human-agent collaboration, and ship real product features primarily through agent-assisted development in collaboration with human colleagues.



We work collaboratively, move fast, and value technical quality. If you are excited about the challenge of building an incredible product while working alongside a great engineering team, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What we’re looking for

 - Strong backend fundamentals in Elixir: API design, data modeling, SQL, service reliability, and debugging production issues.

 - Emphasis on creating scalable and reliable backend systems that integrate seamlessly with multiple services and products with an attention to high-quality code.

 - A drive for exploring and leading new approaches to complex problems via collaboration with multiple stakeholders across Product, Design, and Engineering, particularly amongst one’s peers.

 - Adaptability to the changing tech industry: demonstrated daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow.

 - Ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically: you catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written.

 - Strong system design instincts: you think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail.

 - Clear and empathetic communicator: you flag when a spec has holes, you can articulate why you made a technical choice, you enjoy collaboration and seek to understand different perspectives, and you are constructive in any disagreements.

 - Self-motivation and ownership: you will push your work forward without prompting and look for ways to unblock yourself and the team on business priorities; you enjoy ownership over your work and seeing code through from conception to production.

Skills you already have

 - A passion for Elixir and functional programming

 - 5+ years of professional development using Elixir

 - Solid coding practices including peer code reviews, unit testing, continuous integration, TDD, etc.

 - Experience with relational and/or non-relational databases

 - Experience with microservices

 - Strong understanding of AI tools and ability to identify pitfalls and course correct AI-generated code based on deep knowledge of the fundamentals of building production software

Nice to haves

 - Experience working with Ruby

 - Experience working with GraphQL APIs

 - Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ

 - Experience working on B2B software, on booking flows, or in the travel industry

 - Experience working with payments systems like Stripe

 - Enthusiasm for building and iterating on third party integrations

 - Major bonus points for familiarity with OCTO, the open standard API for tours, activities and attractions

offers.title: ML Engineer - API Platform
offers.description:
WHO WE ARE

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

We’ve made significant progress toward building models that can control many different robots across a wide range of tasks. Now, we’re building the platform that will make those models accessible to the broader world.

As an API Product Engineer, you’ll build the product surface that allows other companies to use Pi’s models much like developers use an LLM API today: bring their own data, fine-tune models, evaluate them, and run low-latency inference in their own environments.

You’ll own this experience end to end, turning capabilities that today require close collaboration with our team into a platform that can eventually support thousands—and ultimately millions—of robots.




THE TEAM

Software Engineering at Pi builds the systems that scale research breakthroughs into reliable products in the physical world.

This role sits at the intersection of our AI, infrastructure, and external partners. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to turn rapidly evolving model capabilities into APIs and tools that external users, from hobbyists to large organizations, can actually build on.

Today, onboarding a new partner to Pi can involve significant hands-on work. The goal is to make that increasingly unnecessary: partners should be able to bring us data, fine-tune a model, evaluate it, and run inference through a product that is intuitive, reliable, and built to scale.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

This is a software and systems role first. Robotics experience is not required, and we’re particularly excited about people who have built developer platforms, model APIs, or infrastructure products outside of robotics.

 - Build Pi’s model API end to end, including data ingestion, fine-tuning, evaluation, low-latency remote inference, partner-facing tools, and deployment integrations.

 - Design systems that can scale from a small number of deeply integrated partners to thousands of organizations and potentially millions of robots.

 - Architect reliable, multi-tenant infrastructure around rate limiting, isolation, backpressure, versioning, observability, and SLOs.

 - Turn partner data into a first-class product experience, from initial upload through validation, processing, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

 - Build and operate low-latency inference systems that allow Pi models to control robots running in real-world environments.

 - Work closely with researchers to turn new model capabilities into stable, usable product surfaces.

 - Learn from how partners use the platform and turn recurring friction into better APIs, tooling, documentation, and abstractions.

 - Write high-quality production code that integrates deeply with Pi’s existing infrastructure.

 - Define what the developer platform for general-purpose robotics should look like. There is no established playbook for this yet.


WHAT WE HOPE YOU'LL BRING

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems.

 - Deep backend and systems experience across APIs, services, databases, caching, distributed systems, and infrastructure.

 - Experience building and scaling developer platforms. We’re especially interested in people who have shipped platforms for model fine-tuning, inference, or other compute-intensive workloads.

 - An understanding of the problems that emerge as systems scale: reliability, latency, multi-tenancy, versioning, observability, and operational complexity.

 - Enough familiarity with machine learning systems to deploy, serve, and debug models in production. You do not need to be an ML researcher.

 - Strong Python skills and the ability to work comfortably across infrastructure and product boundaries.

 - A high degree of ownership. You’re comfortable taking an ambiguous problem, building the first version end to end, and then designing the system so it no longer depends on you.
   
   


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience building low-latency or real-time systems, including streaming, inference transport, WebSockets, QUIC, or similar technologies.

 - Experience building model-serving, inference, fine-tuning, or developer-platform infrastructure.

 - Experience at an early-stage infrastructure, AI, robotics, or autonomous systems company.

 - Familiarity with our stack: Python, Postgres, ClickHouse, GCP, Kubernetes, Modal, React, and TypeScript.

 - Experience with security, authentication, authorization, or multi-tenant infrastructure.
   
   


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - This is not a Customer Success role. You won’t own ongoing partner support or change management inside customer organizations.

 - This is not a Partner Roboticist or Applied Research role. You won’t be responsible for training policies for individual partners or debugging robots on site.

 - This is not a traditional ML infrastructure role focused primarily on training systems, compilers, or accelerator scheduling. You’ll work closely with those systems, but your focus is the product and platform through which the outside world uses Pi’s models.
   
   

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

offers.title: Platform Engineering
offers.description:
PLATFORM ENGINEERING AT POLAR 



Platform engineering at Polar is about building and evolving the systems that power our product – keeping them fast, resilient and simple as we scale. We’re rethinking how billing works for a world of usage-based software, programmable pricing and AI agents – from real-time metering and pricing as code, to more flexible customer identities, giving developers greater control over how they monetize their products.



Polar sits in the critical path of global payments, billing and financial workflows. Reliability and correctness matter deeply, but so does our ability to move quickly.



We’re looking for engineers who enjoy working across infrastructure, backend systems and the application layer – from improving foundational systems and shipping new platform primitives to building the tooling and automation that enable the entire engineering team to move faster.



We don’t believe in building infrastructure for infrastructure’s sake. We value a pragmatic mindset and sensibility in knowing when to introduce new abstractions and when the simplest solution is the right one.



More about Polar and how we work https://polar.sh/company




WHAT YOU COULD WORK ON

Depending on your experience and where you can have the greatest impact, this could include:



 - Keep Polar reliable at scale: Designing and evolving systems that remain highly available, performant and resilient as traffic and complexity grow – identifying bottlenecks, improving critical paths and designing for graceful failure.

 - Evolve our infrastructure: Improving our cloud architecture, infrastructure-as-code and environments – introducing complexity only where it earns its place.

 - Make production safe and easy to operate: Improving observability, debugging, deployments and incident response so engineers can ship confidently, understand what’s happening in production and recover quickly when things go wrong.

 - Build leverage for engineering: Creating primitives, abstractions and automation that remove operational toil and help the broader engineering team move faster.

 - Engineer for financial correctness: Translating financial and regulatory requirements into robust technical systems, with auditability, access control and data integrity built in from the outset.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We’re particularly interested in senior engineers who combine deep systems thinking with exceptional product judgement. People who enjoy solving complex technical problems, take ownership beyond their immediate area and care about building systems that are both robust and easy to work with.



Some of the qualities and experience we value in this area include:

 - Strong technical foundations: Backend and systems engineering experience, including distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and operating production systems at scale. This means that you have built and operated such systems over time to see and understand the pitfalls of the initial decisions

 - SQL and data modelling depth: Strong experience with relational databases, data modelling, query optimization and designing for data integrity and performance.

 - Pragmatic engineering judgement: The ability to reason through complex technical trade-offs, anticipate failure modes and choose solutions that balance immediate needs with long-term maintainability. You’re comfortable moving across infrastructure, backend and application layers to solve the problems that matter.

 - Product-minded: An understanding of how engineering decisions affect the product, with the judgement to balance speed, simplicity and robustness.

 - End-to-end owner: A willingness to take responsibility for outcomes, from understanding the problem and designing a solution to shipping, operating and improving it.

 - Multiplier: An interest in building abstractions, tooling and automation that make the whole engineering team faster and more effective.

 - Security-minded: Treating security, access control and auditability as fundamental engineering considerations rather than afterthoughts.



Experience with payments, billing or financial infrastructure is a strong plus.

We also love seeing open-source contributions and side projects.




OUR STACK

 - Frontend: Typescript (React, Effect)

 - Backend: Python (FastAPI, Dramatiq)

 - Infrastructure: Postgres, Clickhouse, AWS.

offers.title: Software Engineer II - Core Infrastructure
offers.description:
ABOUT POSHMARK


Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression, and human connection. Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind vintage and luxury.

 


🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller Pod and help build the end-to-end experiences that power how sellers list, manage, and grow their businesses on our marketplace. You’ll work across the stack — crafting responsive, intuitive seller-facing interfaces on the frontend and reliable, high-performance services on the backend. This is an exciting opportunity to own features from the database to the browser, collaborate with experienced engineers, and ship products used by millions of sellers every day.


⚙️ WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design, develop, and maintain full stack features that support the seller experience, from listing creation to order and inventory management.

Build responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks.

Develop and maintain backend services and APIs that power seller-facing workflows.

Collaborate with peers and senior engineers to implement scalable, efficient, and maintainable systems across the stack.

Write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code following best practices.

Participate in code reviews and learn from feedback to continually improve.

Troubleshoot and fix issues across the frontend and distributed backend systems in production environments.

Contribute to improving development processes, tooling, and team workflows.

6-Month Accomplishments:

Become proficient with the seller pod’s tech stack, development tools, and codebase across frontend and backend.

Ship production-quality full stack features with guidance from senior team members.

Take ownership of small to medium-sized components or features end-to-end.

Collaborate effectively with Product, QA, and Design teams on feature delivery.

12+ Month Accomplishments:

Independently deliver full stack features from design to production.

Contribute to performance improvements and scalability initiatives on both the client and server side.

Develop a strong understanding of the seller platform’s system architecture and make data-driven technical decisions.

Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas to improve platform reliability, usability, and efficiency.

Mentor interns or new hires joining the team.


💪 WHAT YOU’LL BRING

2- 4 years of professional experience (including internships) in full stack software engineering.

Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

Proficiency in a modern frontend framework (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular) and strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript skills.

Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Ruby, Java, Javascript or Python).

Familiarity with RESTful APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and caching or message-queue systems.

Experience building responsive, user-facing web applications.

Interest in cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, or similar) and scalable architectures.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Collaborative, curious, and motivated to learn and grow within a fast-paced environment.

Pragmatike recrute pour le compte d’une entreprise technologique en forte croissance, orientée produit, qui développe des plateformes traitant d’importants volumes de données et utilisées à grande échelle sur plusieurs marchés. Son produit repose sur l’automatisation, l’extraction de données et des workflows intelligents, avec un fort accent mis sur la fiabilité du backend et la rapidité d’exécution.

Nous recherchons un(e) Full-Stack Engineer à dominante backend, capable de prendre en charge des fonctionnalités de bout en bout. Le poste est réparti à environ 70 % sur le backend et 30 % sur le frontend. Il convient particulièrement aux ingénieurs qui aiment travailler en profondeur sur le backend tout en restant proches du produit et de sa mise en production.

 - Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et engineering pour transformer les besoins en solutions évolutives

 - 4 ans d’expérience ou plus en Full-Stack Engineering ou Backend Engineering

 - Solide expérience backend avec Python et/ou Node.js

 - Bonne maîtrise de PostgreSQL et MongoDB

 - À l’aise pour intervenir ponctuellement sur des bases de code frontend

 - Expérience ou intérêt pour le scraping et les systèmes traitant d’importants volumes de données

 - Bonne connaissance des méthodes modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

 - Forte capacité à prendre des responsabilités et à travailler de manière autonome

 - Être basé(e) en Amérique latine




LES PETITS PLUS

 - Expérience en OCR, computer vision ou traitement de documents

 - Expérience sur des produits fortement orientés automatisation ou data

 - Expérience en startup ou scale-up




POURQUOI CE POSTE PEUT FAIRE ÉVOLUER VOTRE CARRIÈRE

 - Une forte autonomie sur des fonctionnalités directement mises en production

 - Un impact concret sur les systèmes backend au cœur du produit

 - Une exposition à l’automatisation, au scraping et aux workflows intelligents

 - Une utilisation quotidienne d’outils modernes de développement assisté par l’IA

offers.description:
QUINDAR

Quindar builds modern, cloud-native satellite mission operations software with a simple mission: to operate satellites like servers. Our platform replaces fragmented, legacy ground systems with an integrated, automation-driven approach that brings modern software velocity to space operations.

We're a small, fast-moving team with deep aerospace and software roots, energized by big challenges and motivated by the impact we have on real missions in this next chapter of the Space Age. If you want to work with sharp, ambitious people who push boundaries, move quickly, and are excited to take space operations to the next level, Quindar is the place to do it.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 👨‍💻👩‍💻 🛰 🛰

You will be responsible for developing ground satellite operations software using Python and AWS services. Don't worry, you do not need to be an expert in satellites or understand space! Satellites are just flying servers you can connect to every 90 minutes but we connect to hundreds of them.

You will develop APIs, integrate with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, and EKS with a focus on scalability, security, cost, and performance of the software. Working closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, you will implement new features and troubleshoot issues. Your strong knowledge of AWS services and best practices will enable you to optimize resource utilization and automate processes, ultimately contributing to the efficient and reliable operations of thousands of satellites.

You will primarily be responsible for developing backend software capabilities, but the ideal candidate can contribute across backend software development, generative AI integrations, DevSecOps and CI/CD tooling, and software architecture design and maintenance.

Day to day, you will be a part of the engineering team of frontend and backend engineers working in an Agile Scrum environment.

Tech Skills

 - Proficiency in Python, GraphQL, Docker, and Terraform (or relevant Infrastructure-as-Code tools)

 - Strong knowledge of containerized applications

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes cluster deployments

 - Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS

 - Fluency in collaborative development using Git with platforms like GitHub or GitLab

Soft Skills

 - Deep technical analysis and troubleshooting skills

 - Independent self-starter; able to complete projects on time with minimal guidance

 - A high standard for software maintainability, quality, resilience, and performance

 - Strong cross-functional communication between frontend and backend engineers and product managers

Background Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field)

 - 3+ years professional experience in backend development, full stack development or other related role. Professional experience can be replaced with a self-starter who has drive, the technical skills, and is obsessed with their product.

 - U.S. Person status required – we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

 - Ability to obtain U.S. Security Clearance

ITAR REQUIREMENTS

 - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT QUINDAR

 - We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each quarter we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 - Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

offers.title: Software Engineer, Platform
offers.description:
ABOUT REDUCTO

Reducto is the agentic document platform for leading AI teams who demand enterprise performance at scale. We provide a comprehensive toolkit for working with documents the way a human would, combining custom in-house and leading frontier models to power efficient and accurate document workflows.

We’ve grown rapidly, increasing revenue 8x year over year and partnering with hundreds of companies, from leading AI teams like Harvey, Vanta, and Scale, to enterprise customers across FAANG and top trading firms.

Reducto has raised over $100M from world-class investors including a16z, Benchmark, and First Round Capital.




THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Software Engineer on Platform, you’ll own the infrastructure behind Reducto’s core API: the systems that make document understanding fast, reliable, and cost-efficient at scale. You’ll work across Python services, queues, model-serving paths, Kubernetes/container infrastructure, observability, and developer tooling to make Reducto’s platform increasingly bulletproof as usage grows.

This is a high-leverage infra role. The ideal person has built and operated real production systems, cares deeply about latency/reliability/cost, is comfortable leading technical direction for a small team, and uses modern LLM coding tools fluently to move faster. 




WE WOULD LOVE TO MEET YOU IF YOU:

 - Have 5+ years building, hardening, and scaling production backend/platform systems. 

 - Have hands-on experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes or similar orchestration, cloud infrastructure, observability, and incident-driven reliability work. 

 -  Are strong in Python, or deeply expert in another backend language and excited to work primarily in Python. 

 - Have used Terraform/IaC, containerized deployments, and production debugging workflows. 

 - Are highly fluent with LLM coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and use them as part of your daily engineering loop. 

 - Have led projects or small teams, raised engineering quality, and can communicate clearly with founders, engineers, and occasionally customers.
   
   


THE CORE WORK WILL INCLUDE:

 - Scaling Reducto’s core API and document processing pipelines for higher throughput and lower latency. 

 - Reducing infrastructure and model-serving costs without sacrificing quality or reliability.

 - Improving Kubernetes/containerized deployment workflows, observability, alerting, and operational safety. 

 - Building internal tooling, evals, and debugging workflows that help engineers find and fix failures quickly. 

 - Partnering with ML/backend engineers to optimize LLM/model-serving paths in production.

 - Acting as a technical lead for platform/backend projects as the team grows.
   
   


BONUS POINTS IF YOU:

 - Have built infrastructure at an early-stage or high-growth startup. 

 - Have worked on AI infrastructure, model-serving, agent platforms, developer tools, or high-throughput APIs. 

 - Have meaningful experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, queues, Postgres, observability, or cloud cost optimization. 

 - Are comfortable talking with customers or translating customer pain into platform improvements.

 -  Keep up with modern AI/LLM tooling and actively use it to improve your engineering workflow.

This is an in person role at our office in SF. We're an early stage company which means that the role requires working hard and moving quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.







BENEFITS AT REDUCTO

At Reducto, we’re invested in the well-being and growth of our team. Here’s what we currently offer:

 - Unlimited PTO: We believe great work requires recharging.

 - Lunch: Receive a free lunch to eat with your teammates daily at the office

 - Reimbursed Transportation: Provide us with your receipts and we’ll take care of the costs

 - Insurance: Generous health insurance covering medical, dental, and vision.

 - Health and Wellness Budget: We provide up to $150/mo reimbursement for health and wellness spending, such as gym memberships, fitness classes, or similar.

 - Parental Leave: Work with us to build a leave schedule that works for you and your family



Reducto is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

offers.title: Software Engineer, Trust & Safety
offers.description:
Resend is growing fast, and there are now over 4 million developers using it. We’re building tools that make email better for developers. We care about dependable infrastructure, thoughtful design, and the experience of everyone building with our products.

In this role you'll build the anti-abuse systems that keep Resend open for good senders and closed to bad actors: real-time enforcement on every email, detection pipelines that scale with the platform, and automations that go from detection to action without waiting on a human.

This role is fully remote based in Americas or European timezones, with some expected travel for team offsites, conferences, meetups, and more.

Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here https://resend.com/handbook.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL…

 - Build and run the real-time enforcement layer within a latency budget of milliseconds

 - Design pipelines that move from signal to decision to action, across sending, receiving and account activity

 - Build the detection rules and policies that decide when we act, and make them safe to change

 - Detect and contain account takeover and leaked API keys: notice when a trusted account stops acting like itself, and stop the damage without locking out the real owner

 - Close the feedback loop: every block and every reversal carries a reason, so we can measure each detection's precision and retire the ones that hurt good senders

 - Automate manual work such as investigations, appeals and bulk actions, so the team keeps up as volume grows

 - Build and evaluate ML classifiers for spam and phishing, and prove their precision before they enforce anything

 - Implement safeguards and make every action traceable through logs, metrics and audit trails

 - Ensure all enforcement actions are traceable with logs, metrics, and audit trails




YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

 - Bring 5+ years of software engineering experience

 - Are fluent in writing and speaking English

 - Have deep experience with Node.js, TypeScript, React (Hono, Next.js)

 - Write Go, or want to, for latency-sensitive services

 - Have infrastructure and reliability skills (AWS, CDK, Datadog)

 - Are comfortable with APIs, event-driven architectures, queues and stateful services

 - Design systems that fail safe, and treat a false positive as a bug

 - Care deeply about observability: metrics, logs, tracing, error handling

 - Take ownership across the stack, from frontend surfaces down to databases and queues

 - Have proven experience with databases (Postgres, Redis)




YOU WILL BE AN EXCEPTIONAL FIT IF YOU ALSO...

 - Have worked in trust and safety, fraud or security

 - Have built real-time enforcement such as rate limiting, or a rules engine on a policy language like CEL

 - Have shipped ML or LLM-based detection in production, and know how to measure its precision and recall

 - Know email: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounces, complaints, and how phishing campaigns work

 - Have knowledge of database performance tuning (Postgres, Redis)




WHAT IT MEANS TO JOIN THE TEAM:

 - Room to shape technical decisions and take projects from discovery through production

 - Work remotely with teammates around the world

 - Close collaboration with the developers who use what you build

 - Teammates who value thoughtful feedback, shared learning, and care for each other

 - A high bar for product quality, reliability, and the details that make software enjoyable to use

 - Comp: $150,000 - $175,000 USD, commensurate with location and experience




LEARN MORE ABOUT HOW WE WORK:

 - Our philosophy for anti-abuse https://resend.com/handbook/support/what-is-our-philosophy-for-anti-abuse

 - $3M to make email safer https://resend.com/blog/3-million-to-make-email-safer

 - Revoking leaked API keys with GitHub secret scanning https://resend.com/changelog/github-secret-scanner




ABOUT RESEND

We are building the modern email sending platform for developers. We care deeply about quality, craft, and the developer experience.

Our fully remote team of 50 spans 15 countries and counting. We're backed by a16z, Y Combinator, and others. Meet the humans → https://resend.com/humans

offers.title: Support Software Engineer
offers.description:
At Replicant, we believe AI should work for people, starting with customer service. That’s why we built a platform that helps contact centers resolve more requests, proactively identify issues, and improve agent performance with AI-powered conversation intelligence and AI agents that act like your best reps.

Our AI agents handle millions of calls every month for Fortune 500 companies and high-growth innovators. From processing payments to booking appointments and authenticating users, they help customers get what they need instantly, 24/7. Meanwhile, our real-time conversation insights help contact center leaders coach better and improve every interaction.

We’re leading the shift from legacy systems to AI-first service, powered by large language models (LLMs) and designed for enterprise scale, security, and empathy. If you’re excited by the potential of LLMs, voice AI, and building category-defining technology with a kind, ambitious team, you’ll love it here.

Our customers don't just buy an AI agent that works in a demo. They buy one that keeps resolving calls, holds up under real call volumes, and stays reliable as their business changes underneath it. As a Support Software Engineer on our Technical Support team, you make that true once a bot or product is live: you own the fixes and enhancements that keep it running, dig through logs, code, and conversation data to find out why something broke, and build the internal tools that make the next investigation faster than the last one. This is a post-launch engineering role, equal parts investigator, fixer, and customer point of contact, and you are measured on reliability and resolution, not features shipped. It's also a genuinely broad technical mandate spanning AI Agent behavior, Conversation Intelligence, telephony, integrations, and legacy TypeScript SDK bots and you'll build it on real production traffic, not demos, with real autonomy on a team small enough that your work is visible to customers and leadership alike.



What You'll Do

 - Own the bugs, issues, and enhancement requests for bots and products once they're live in production, working the escalations frontline Support Engineers can't resolve on their own.

 - Take a holistic view of platform health: AI Agent behavior and configuration, Conversation Intelligence, telephony, SSO and authentication, integrations, API issues, LLM prompting, and legacy FSM AI Agents built in TypeScript.

 - Investigate root cause across logs, code, and Replicant's internal tooling, then design, implement, test, and ship the fix, using agentic coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor as a core part of how you work.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for customers on live issues: gather and confirm requirements on bugs and enhancement requests, and coordinate testing directly with them.

 - Act as an escalation point for frontline Support Engineers, providing technical context and guidance on the issues they can't close alone.

 - Build and maintain the internal tools that make the next investigation, fix, or enhancement faster than the last one.

 - Gather and raise customer feedback to Product, and adhere to team SLAs and support metrics along the way.



What you'll bring

 - Debugging depth. You're comfortable reading unfamiliar code, tracing logs, and reasoning across a genuinely broad surface area: production debugging, distributed systems, REST APIs, and authentication (OAuth 2.0 and similar) are all second nature, and you don't need to be a specialist in just one system.

 - Agentic fluency. You use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as your default way of investigating and fixing issues, not as a novelty layered on top of how you used to work, and you're just as comfortable maintaining legacy TypeScript code where that's still what's running in production.

 - Customer-facing strength. You can gather requirements directly from customers, confirm reproduction steps, coordinate tests, and explain a fix in plain language, including with customers who are frustrated that something broke.

 - Nice to have: experience with LLM prompting or debugging conversational AI/voice systems; experience with enterprise tools like Salesforce, Zendesk, or Jira; experience building internal tooling or automations that reduced manual engineering or support load.

For all full-time employees, we offer:



🌴  In-person connection that counts: company-wide offsites and smaller team gatherings designed to make remote work feel personal

🖥️  Tech & learning stipend: Conferences, books, courses — interested? We’ll fund them

📍  Remote by design: We’re distributed — no guilt about life events, we trust you to manage your calendar

🏋️  Health & wellness: Flexible vacations, paid sabbatical after 5 years, comprehensive benefits, plus a stipend to support your physical and mental well-being

💸  Compensation that matches your impact: competitive salaries in the company you’re helping to build

📈  Equity with upside: We believe in shared ownership—You’ll own a real piece of a fast-growing AI company



Our Values

Replicant has three core values. It is critical that everyone who joins the team feels excited and moved by these values as every new team member makes an impact on our culture.



Blade Runners: We take ownership and pride to influence the outcomes of our goals. We are successful, and like a Blade Runner, use the tools at our disposal to reach our objectives. We value open and honest communication and proactively seek feedback along the way. We are a company driven to grow and achieve both individually and as a team.



Bread Makers: We are humble and strive toward an egalitarian culture. No task is too big or too small. We work together to achieve our goals and develop our company mission. We believe that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts in everything that we do.



Självdistans (Self-Distance): Självdistans is Swedish for self-distance. It's the ability to critically reflect on oneself and one's relations from an external perspective. With this in mind, we act with objectivity and always remember that we are not our work. There's no perfect science to growing a team or business, but we trust everyone at Replicant to point out our blind spots and humbly admit their own.



Replicant is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at talent@replicant.ai hr@replicant.ai and we’ll work to meet your needs.

offers.title: Software Engineer
offers.description:
Chi siamo

In Italia, gestire la finanza di una PMI o di uno studio significa fare i conti con strumenti che non si parlano, rincorrere fatture ed estratti conto, impazzire dietro alle scadenze.

Il risultato? Tempo perso, decisioni prese troppo tardi, zero crescita.

Sibill cambia tutto questo: fatturazione, pagamenti, tesoreria e contabilità di PMI e commercialisti, tutto in un'unica piattaforma potenziata dall'intelligenza artificiale.

Oggi oltre 5.000 aziende e più di 300 studi lavorano con Sibill. Nel 2025 abbiamo chiuso un round da 12 milioni di euro guidato da Creandum, il fondo che ha creduto in Spotify, Klarna e Trade Republic.

I nostri valori sono ambizione, pragmatismo, efficienza e integrità. Tradotto: non accontentarsi mai, tagliare le riunioni inutili, avvisare subito il cliente quando c'è un problema, dare feedback onesti anche al proprio manager.

Per crescere cerchiamo persone curiose, capaci di semplificare la complessità e di rimettere in discussione lo status quo, in altre parole la “cazzimma”.

Se quello che hai letto ti ha acceso anche solo un po', candidati: ti aspetta un team di oltre 130 persone di talento.


COSA FARAI

Entrerai a far parte del team Engineering e lavorerai su tutto il ciclo di sviluppo del prodotto, contribuendo a progettare, sviluppare e migliorare funzionalità utilizzate ogni giorno dai nostri clienti.

Nel concreto ti occuperai di:

 - progettare e sviluppare funzionalità end-to-end, dall'idea al rilascio, e misurarne l'impatto reale sugli utenti

 - fare evolvere la codebase e l'infrastruttura, mantenendole veloci, manutenibili e affidabili al crescere dei volumi e dell’offerta prodotti

 - fare code reviews e portare le tue best practices nel team, imparando dalle sue

 - lavorare ogni giorno con i team di product, data, design, infra, tech support e altri per trasformare problemi complessi in soluzioni semplici


COME LAVORIAMO

 - lavoriamo in team cross-funzionali. Quando profili e competenze diverse si mettono insieme per risolvere problemi complessi, magic happens

 - proviamo a minimizzare meetings e cerimonie. Privilegiamo tempo di qualità e focus

 - partiamo dal cliente, capiamo il problema e andiamo a ritroso. La soluzione è l’ultima cosa

 - siamo veloci, pragmatici e ambiziosi nel fare i trade-offs. Pensiamo soprattutto che avere il giusto contesto e una profonda conoscenza di dominio aiuti a fare scelte tecniche migliori


CHI STIAMO CERCANDO

Cerchiamo una persona con almeno 4 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software, curiosa, pragmatica e con voglia di costruire.

Ci piacerebbe se avessi:

offers.title: AI Engineer
offers.description:
Chi siamo

In Italia, gestire la finanza di una PMI o di uno studio significa fare i conti con strumenti che non si parlano, rincorrere fatture ed estratti conto, impazzire dietro alle scadenze.

Il risultato? Tempo perso, decisioni prese troppo tardi, zero crescita.

Sibill cambia tutto questo: fatturazione, pagamenti, tesoreria e contabilità di PMI e commercialisti, tutto in un'unica piattaforma potenziata dall'intelligenza artificiale.

Oggi oltre 5.000 aziende e più di 300 studi lavorano con Sibill. Nel 2025 abbiamo chiuso un round da 12 milioni di euro guidato da Creandum, il fondo che ha creduto in Spotify, Klarna e Trade Republic.

I nostri valori sono ambizione, pragmatismo, efficienza e integrità. Tradotto: non accontentarsi mai, tagliare le riunioni inutili, avvisare subito il cliente quando c'è un problema, dare feedback onesti anche al proprio manager.

Per crescere cerchiamo persone curiose, capaci di semplificare la complessità e di rimettere in discussione lo status quo, in altre parole la “cazzimma”.

Se quello che hai letto ti ha acceso anche solo un po', candidati: ti aspetta un team di oltre 130 persone di talento.


COSA FARAI

Riporterai direttamente all’head of AI. Con lei costruirai i prodotti AI che aiutano i nostri clienti a gestire meglio il proprio business. Non sarà un lavoro in solitaria: collaborerai ogni giorno con i team data, engineering, infra, product e design.

Lavoriamo sui dati più critici di un'azienda: flussi di cassa, transazioni bancarie, fatture, corrispettivi, crediti e debiti, registrazioni di contabilità generale. Siamo il sistema operativo di finanza e contabilità dei nostri clienti. Il tuo compito sarà sfruttare questo patrimonio informativo per risolvere problemi concreti dei clienti.

Le tue responsabilità includeranno:

 - Discovery, comprensione del dominio e sperimentazione

 - Design e sviluppo di sistemi AI in produzione

 - Definizione e gestione di evals: metriche, dataset di test, monitoraggio di qualità, costi e latenza

 - Iterazione continua sui prodotti AI esistenti, scegliendo di volta in volta l'approccio più adatto. Il lavoro non è “done” quando il modello è in prod, ma quando i clienti lo usano quotidianamente e ne sono dipendenti

Alcuni esempi di progetti su cui potresti lavorare dal primo mese:

 - Introdurre re-ranking nel nostro algoritmo di riconciliazione automatica.

 - Costruire un nuovo sistema di knowledge management, retrieval, memory e tool use per gli AI agents di Sibill.

 - Seguire training e evals di un modello linguistico per le transazioni bancarie italiane.


CHI STIAMO CERCANDO

 - Hai una laurea magistrale o un dottorato in Computer Science, Data Science, Ingegneria, Matematica o altra disciplina STEM. Basi solide di matematica, statistica, probabilità e machine learning faranno la differenza.

 - Hai esperienza concreta e casi di successo nel costruire e portare in produzione applicazioni AI-based usate da migliaia di utenti.

 - Non hai preso scorciatoie: conosci le basi (modelli lineari, algebra lineare, reti neurali, backprop) e padroneggi il “basso livello”.

 - Padroneggi Python moderno e gli strumenti dello sviluppo software (git, Docker, CI/CD, unit testing, evals). Non runniamo data pipeline su Jupyter Notebook in produzione.

 - Conosci le API dei principali provider di modelli e i framework dell'ecosistema, ma sai anche quando farne a meno.

 - Hai una mentalità di ownership end-to-end, soprattutto all'inizio. Non succederà ogni giorno, ma se serve potresti dover costruire una data pipeline da zero, scrivere un ETL batch, scrivere codice in Elixir o TypeScript, o supportare i colleghi con un'analisi empirica puntuale.

 - Parli fluentemente italiano e inglese.

 - Punto bonus: almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza nel software o nel ML, di cui una parte su sistemi AI in produzione. Hai già fatto coaching e mentoring a colleghi junior.

Se:

 - non ti senti "arrivato/a", sei un builder e vuoi restare hands-on

 - ti entusiasma lavorare in un ambiente flat, senza politica e ad alta velocità

 - hai ottime capacità analitiche e grande attenzione ai dettagli

 - hai high ownership e high agency

 - ti ritrovi nei valori che condividiamo in Sibill: ambizione, pragmatismo, efficienza, integrità

probabilmente sei un ottimo fit!
